clients.name: Claude Code
clients.kind: Plugin with skills and MCP server
clients.detail: Adds the plugin marketplace from GitHub, then installs the plugin with its two skills and the MCP server.

clients.name: Codex
clients.kind: Plugin with skills and MCP server
clients.detail: The Codex CLI and app read the same plugin from the repository's plugin marketplace.
commands: codex plugin marketplace add EvotecIT/OfficeIMO --ref master --sparse .agents/plugins

clients.name: VS Code with GitHub Copilot
clients.detail: Installs the MCP server for agent mode, with the open workspace folder as the folder it may read and write.

clients.name: Cursor
clients.detail: Adds the MCP server to Cursor, with the open workspace folder as the folder it may read and write.

clients.name: Claude Desktop
clients.detail: Add the server under mcpServers in Settings › Developer › Edit Config, with the folders it may use, then restart Claude.

clients.name: Gemini CLI, JetBrains, Windsurf, Zed and other MCP clients
clients.detail: Any client that starts local stdio MCP servers runs the same command; set the allowed folders in its environment.

skills.name: officeimo-document-operator
skills.detail: Inspect, search, summarize, extract or convert Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, OpenDocument, OneNote, Markdown, HTML, CSV and EPUB files, and make separate PDF outputs.

skills.name: officeimo-mailbox-operator
skills.detail: Search and inspect MSG, EML, PST, OST, OLM, EMLX and Mbox mail without loading a whole mailbox into the conversation.

tools.name: officeimo_inspect
tools.detail: Metadata and a structural summary of a document or mail store

tools.name: officeimo_inspect_email
tools.detail: Mail metadata, charset and attachment diagnostics, and HTML safety findings

tools.name: officeimo_search
tools.detail: Search a document or mailbox and return hits to fetch selectively

tools.name: officeimo_search_email
tools.detail: Bounded search of mail bodies, recipients and attachment names

tools.name: officeimo_fetch
tools.detail: Fetch one chosen result, a page at a time

tools.name: officeimo_capabilities
tools.detail: Which formats and operations are supported

tools.name: officeimo_convert
tools.detail: Write a document as Markdown or Reader JSON

tools.name: officeimo_pdf
tools.detail: Extract pages, decrypt with the owner's password, flatten, optimize or sanitize into a new PDF

tools.name: officeimo_pdf_split
tools.detail: Split a PDF into parts in a new folder

tools.name: officeimo_pdf_assemble
tools.detail: Combine PDFs and images, in order, into one PDF

tools.name: officeimo_pdf_ocr
tools.detail: Make a searchable copy of a scanned PDF

tools.name: officeimo_pdf_print_plan
tools.detail: Plan printed sheets without contacting a printer

tools.name: officeimo_pdf_compare
tools.detail: Compare pages of two PDFs and save an HTML report
